bugs_found: transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal: float/string inputs can raise TypeError mid-flow instead of controlled validation
transfer is non-atomic: after debiting source, crediting destination can fail if account_to.balance is invalid/incompatible, leaving balances inconsistent
transfer accepts unvalidated account objects/fields; malformed balance/currency/id values can cause runtime failures or corrupt receipts
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction value
fx_convert accepts zero or negative FX rates from rates, producing zero/negative converted amounts without validation
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing fractional inputs without explicit rejection
money outputs are never quantized to currency precision, allowing silent fractional-cent results and rounding drift
